static_KV_scales.lifetime: loaded once, retained across fragments and prefill/decode

embedding_rows_INT8.lane_selector_storage: two-bit descriptor field per row, written by validated DMA aux; not CPU tensor processing

static_KV_scales.padding: entry bytes 12..15 zero; entries contain 3 K FP32 scales and 12 V FP32 scales

physical_memory: Capacity calculations are logical byte requirements; BRAM/URAM rounding, striping, port routing and timing require separate implementation evidence.

port_candidates.native_address_unit: 128-bit words; wide request uses an even word address

DMA_rules.data_and_scale: separate explicit transfers or macro-expanded typed DMA; padding initialized to zero
DMA_rules.sidecar: fixed offset from bank descriptor, never supplied to GEMM as raw offset
DMA_rules.partial_data_validity: Track expected data and scale intervals separately; a successful partial transfer does not make the entire tensor ready

descriptor_lifecycle.BANK_CONFIG_candidate: Only while free; sets a validated profile, dimensions, generation and expected data/scale intervals; invalidates the previous tensor. Contains no tensor arithmetic or DDR address. Encoding pending.
descriptor_lifecycle.quantization_destination: Profile/dimensions established from accepted command; commits only after all output data and scale writes accepted.
descriptor_lifecycle.DMA_destination: Configured expected byte intervals must all complete successfully; pending segments remain invalid. A DMA-load command can target the configured invalid bank.
descriptor_lifecycle.failure: Destination invalid; no stale descriptor or scale reuse. Error/completion identity rules retained.
descriptor_lifecycle.completion: Release only matched accepted bank roles after all memory responses processed and final data/scale writes accepted.
descriptor_lifecycle.END_and_FENCE: Drain without clearing data, metadata or DDR cache state.
descriptor_lifecycle.B7_components: One bank lock; independently track RoPE-window and static-table validity. Reconfiguring/loading the RoPE window must preserve static scales. A command checks only the required component. Neither data nor scale is cleared by END/START.

compute_operands.GEMM_INT8: A8 bank, B8 bank, BF16 destination; shapes and logical output tile indices; A/B scales reside in their respective banks
compute_operands.ATTN_SCORE_INT8: B14 Q8, B8 K8, B10 BF16 score; rows/position/context; adapter selects GQA head and scale
compute_operands.ATTN_VALUE_INT8: B13 P8, B9 V8, B11 BF16 context; rows/context; adapter transposes V tile and selects scale
compute_operands.QUANTIZE: BF16 source, B7 static-scale table bank when required, INT8 destination; dynamic A/Q/P or static K/V profile; ignores unused scale-table operand rather than acquiring bank 0
compute_operands.DEQUANTIZE: INT8 source with row scales, BF16 destination; embedding row conversion; scale and tensor are read under the same source ownership

prefill_decode_schedule_candidate: At initialization DMA-load B7 static subregion once.
Gather embedding rows and corresponding tied-weight scales into B3, then PL dequantize to B0.
Norm B0 -> B2; quantize B2 -> B13 once; reuse B13 for Q/K/V projections.
Project Q/K/V -> B4/B5/B6; RoPE Q/K; quantize Q -> B14, K -> B8, V -> B9 using B7 for K/V.
DMA-store current K/V payload only to their position offsets, then FENCE.
Restore full K/V INT8 prefix and layer scales to B8/B9; run QK -> B10.
Softmax produces BF16 P in B10; quantize -> B13; run PV -> B11.
Quantize context -> B13; O projection -> B1; residual -> B5.
Norm B5 -> B2; quantize -> B13 once; gate/up reuse A13 and replace B8/B9 only after attention completion.
SiLU -> B10; quantize -> B13; down -> B1; residual -> B0.
Final norm -> B2; quantize only selected last row into B13; lm_head -> B12; DMA-store BF16 logits.

ISA_weight_schedule.status: explicit-ISA policy agreed; bit encoding and BANK_CONFIG contract still draft
per_tile: GEMM_INT8 A, selected weight bank, BF16 destination
ISA_weight_schedule.bank_selection: tile index even -> B3; odd -> B15
ISA_weight_schedule.overlap: After GEMM(tile i) acceptance, the next record may configure/load tile i+1 into the other bank while GEMM i is outstanding. GEMM i+1 stalls at current PC until A/output ownership and the shared core are available.
ISA_weight_schedule.no_lookahead: Only current PC issues; PS orders all preload and GEMM records.
ISA_weight_schedule.no_hidden_DDR: Ordinary compute receives only local bank IDs; all DDR reads are DMA_LOAD records.
ISA_weight_schedule.release: Weight bank reusable only after matched GEMM completion following final BF16 output write; not merely the last weight read.
ISA_weight_schedule.fragment_rule: At most15 work records plus END; END drains accepted operations but preserves ready or partially filled tensor/scale descriptors. PS upload gaps are counted separately.
ISA_weight_schedule.A_reuse: Same A8 bank retained as valid data across all N tiles and across Q/K/V or gate/up projections; its ownership releases per matched GEMM completion.
ISA_weight_schedule.scope: Projection and lm_head weight residency; attention operands remain K/V cache banks.
